subject: Mutual Action Plan & Kickoff — QuarryHealth onboarding
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@quarryhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@quarryhealth.com>, procurement@quarryhealth.com
Date: 2026-02-25T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood eval — next steps

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. The team is excited and wants a simple execution plan so we can align Legal/IT/Prod. Procurement will need an outline of milestones and deliverables with owners and dates to attach to the SOW. Can you share a mutual action plan (MAP) we can use?

High level asks from our side:
- Data residency confirmation and a short list of required artifacts for the security review
- A realistic go-live timeline (we target 8–10 weeks from signed SOW)
- Points of contact for each stage (integration, validation, CS handoff)

If you can send a draft MAP and timeline this week we’ll circulate to IT + Procurement.

— Nora
Nora Patel
VP Product Operations, QuarryHealth
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@quarryhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & Kickoff — QuarryHealth onboarding

Nora — thanks, and appreciate the clarity on procurement’s needs. Attaching a draft MAP and an initial implementation timeline for your review. Key assumptions are listed on tab 1 of the spreadsheet (MAP_v1):
- Production dataset size: ~120GB (dedicated inference)
- Integration pattern: API + SFTP for batch imports
- Regulatory: US-only region for PHI adjacency; we recommend Redwood Private (VPC) for auditability

Highlights from the attached:
1) Discovery & Security review (weeks 1–2) — owner: QuarryHealth IT + Redwood Security (Soojin)
2) Integration sprints (weeks 3–6) — owner: QuarryHealth Eng + Redwood Eng (Marissa)
3) Validation & QA (weeks 7–8) — owner: QuarryHealth PM + Redwood CS (Ben)
4) Cutover & go-live (week 9–10) — owner: QuarryHealth Ops + Redwood Ops (Monica)

I’ve included a procurement-friendly milestone table (with deliverables for Legal), and a short evidence bundle list (SOC 2 report link, encryption/KMS whitepaper, onboarding checklist). If Procurement wants, we can produce a one-page timeline PDF for signatures.

Attachments: [Quarry_MAP_v1.xlsx] [Quarry_Implementation_Timeline_v1.pdf]

Next steps suggestion:
- You review and mark any hard constraints on dates/teams by Fri 3/5
- I’ll coordinate a 30-minute alignment call (internal kickoff) 3/8 to finalize obligations

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: QuarryHealth MAP — review + risk notes

Team — quick internal note after my pass on the attached MAP:
- Integration risk: Quarry’s API team has a narrow change window (only two maintenance weekends in April). We should plan an integration sprint that respects those windows; otherwise we risk a delay to weeks 5–8.
- Security evidence: Soojin, can you prepare a short runbook listing exact docs and turnaround estimates for SOC 2/pen test artifacts? Procurement will want dates.
- CS readiness: Ben/Monica — propose we assign a CS TAM and schedule shadow sessions during validation weeks 7–8 to shorten time-to-value at cutover.

I’ll prepare two alternate sequences in the timeline: a) maintenance-window-aligned plan and b) accelerated plan with a small weekend ops bump (higher risk). Priyom — want to sync with Nora before we finalize.

-Marissa
Director, Customer Success (onboarding), Redwood Inference
From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@quarryhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@quarryhealth.com>, procurement@quarryhealth.com
Date: 2026-03-10T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & Kickoff — QuarryHealth onboarding

Thanks — this looks good. Procurement asked for one small change: they need the milestone table to include acceptance criteria for each deliverable (e.g., integration endpoints validated, sample inference accuracy checks with baseline prompts). I’ve attached a short Procurement checklist — if you can merge acceptance criteria into the MAP, we can sign next week.

Also: our legal team flagged a data-retention question for private deployments — can Redwood confirm default retention windows and an export path for historical logs? If not in the MAP, please add as an action item and owner.

We’re targeting a signed SOW by 3/18 if your team can get the final MAP + updated timeline by 3/12.

— Nora
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@quarryhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-12T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final MAP & Kickoff plan — QuarryHealth (deliverable + owners + dates)

Team — attaching the updated MAP that merges Procurement acceptance criteria and the data-retention/export action item (Soojin will own the retention write-up; Marissa added the maintenance-window alternative timeline).

Key updates:
- Acceptance criteria column added for each milestone (integration: endpoint tests + sample inference pass rate >= 92%; validation: end-to-end smoke + 30-sample accuracy audit)
- Data retention: default logs retention = 90 days; export path: monthly S3 export + on-request full export within 5 business days (owner: Soojin Lee)
- Kickoff: internal alignment call scheduled 2026-03-15T10:00:00-07:00 (Priyom/Marissa/Soojin + Quarry stakeholders) — calendar invite sent separately
- CS handoff: Ben Carter will be primary TAM for go-live; Monica Patel will own post-implementation health checks (30/60/90 day cadence)

Attachments: [Quarry_MAP_v1.xlsx] [Quarry_Implementation_Timeline_v1.pdf] [Procurement_Checklist_Quarry.pdf]

Next steps:
1) Quarry signs SOW by 3/18
2) Kickoff call 3/15 to finalize sprint owners and confirm maintenance windows
3) Redwood to produce one-page procurement-friendly timeline by 3/13 for signature (Priyom)

If anyone sees a blocker before the call, flag it here. Otherwise I’ll publish the final MAP to the shared Drive and mark this thread as the canonical handoff.

Thanks all —
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
